name: Band Chest Fly
focus: Chest and front of the shoulders
description: With a resistance band around your upper back and an end in each hand, open your arms wide at shoulder height, then sweep them together in front of your chest as if hugging a tree.

source.title: Garage Strength: Resistance band chest exercises
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Wrap the band around your upper back, under your arms.
Hold an end in each hand, arms out wide.
cues: Elbows softly bent, as if hugging a tree.
Squeeze your chest at the front.

prescription.note: A soft bend in the elbows the whole way; open slowly.

keyframes.name: Arms wide
keyframes.cue: Band round your upper back, arms out wide at shoulder height.

keyframes.name: Hug
keyframes.cue: Sweep your arms together in front of your chest.
